anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Before the excursion, reflux flow was 0.423 and buffer differential pressure was 2.004 mbar, consistent with the preceding baseline.
Reflux flow rose to 0.658 and buffer differential pressure to 3.703 mbar together; an unexplained transient departure from baseline.
Readings partially recovered to 0.501 and 2.244 mbar; the available data do not distinguish a commanded transition from a process disturbance.

System pressure is 299.184 mbar, column differential pressure -0.249 mbar, cooling-water flow 3.643, and both level switches remain 1; no sustained system-pressure or cooling-water departure is evident.

args.missing_evidence: Protocol phase and reflux setpoint/valve-command history around 1140–1200 s, followed by further flow and pressure readings, to determine whether the excursion was expected. Temperature instruments are not installed, so thermal execution cannot be checked from this stream. A composition measurement and target specification are needed to assess separation.
